name: automation-flip-watcher
description: Executable automation plugin for Automation Flip Watcher: watches enabled cron automations on the OSS automation VM and alerts Slack within the hour when one flips from consistently passing to consistently failing, goes silent-failed, or stops running on cadence.

scope.description: Automation names to watch (case-insensitive). Empty watches every enabled cron automation except this watcher.

exclude.description: Automation names to skip regardless of scope.

fail_threshold.description: Consecutive failed runs that count as consistently failing.

healthy_streak.description: Consecutive passing runs that establish a healthy baseline and confirm recovery.

watch_window_hours.description: How far back each run reads the runs table.

realert_hours.description: Minimum gap between repeat alerts for an automation still failing.

alert_channel.description: Slack channel id for alerts and the daily heartbeat.

slack_token_secret.description: Registered secret name holding the Slack bot token for alert_channel.

canvas_url.description: Canvas base URL used to link alerting runs to their conversations.

db_path.description: Path to the automation service's SQLite database, opened read-only.

conversations_dir.description: Directory of dev conversations used for the silent-failure check.

heartbeat_hour_utc.description: UTC hour the daily heartbeat posts in.

silent_failure_check.description: Check whether the newest COMPLETED run's conversation ended error/stuck.

stale_check_enabled.description: Alert when an enabled automation in scope stops running on its cron cadence.
